tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
GENERAL CONDITONS AS PER BRIEF BID

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be the manufacturer/Authorized dealer/supplier and shall have proven experience in similar field & supplied similar items to any State Govt. / Central Govt. / Govt. undertakings/reputed organization in India.In proof of the above, Purchase order copy of total order value not less than Rs.63,500/- in a Single purchase order and invoice copy/supply completion certificate issued from competent authority shall be furnished. The purchase order copy furnished shall be of the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22 2022-23,2023-24 ,2024-25,2025-26 and the period up to the date of submission of bid). The work orders of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Single purchase order and invoice copy/supply completion certificate issued from competent authority shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidders in the last five financial years(i.e.,2021-22 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 &2025-26) should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.1.27 Lakhs. In proof, Annual report/turn over certificates duly certified by chartered accountant shall be furnished. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.
